product.name: Veridian PulseDoor 100
product.description: The Veridian PulseDoor 100 is a compact, Wi‑Fi enabled doorbell designed for modern homes. It delivers clear two‑way audio, motion‑triggered alerts, and a bright LED indicator that syncs with the user’s smartphone app. The unit supports Matter, Zigbee, and standard Wi‑Fi 802.11 b/g/n, allowing seamless integration with existing smart‑home ecosystems. Battery operation is optional, with a 12‑hour standby time on a single AA set, while the 5‑W AC adapter provides continuous power for wired installations. The brushed aluminum housing and tempered glass front give a sleek, durable finish that resists fingerprints and scratches. Ideal for entryways, apartments, or small houses, it offers reliable connectivity and intuitive setup.
